title: Part Four: Nick Land, the Engine

sections.brief: Land at Warwick 1987-98; CCRU (Plant 1995, Land from 1997); accelerationism defined (Deleuze-Guattari, Noys 2010); the 2013 left/right split (Williams and Srnicek vs 'flat tire'); e/acc and the violent terror usage kept distinct; Shanghai; Spectator 2025 and Andreessen 'patron saint'. Figures: compare; time

The ten-instalment serial (2 Mar-20 Jul 2012) summarised part by part; Thiel 2009 quote p. 2; what Land credits to Moldbug (Cathedral, neocameralism, Universalism, no enemies to the left) vs his own additions (parasitology, feedback, China's Modernity 2.0, hard money, speciation); what the text does not contain. Figures: flow; compare

Hereditarian race claims in Land's voice (pp. 13-14, 30, 41, 52); the genocide sentence in context; what he rejects (white nationalism, antisemitic turn, Nazism) and concedes (Saletan, Millman); Hitler as 'mirror Messiah'; exit as sorting from white flight to speciation; 'Hyper-Racism' (4 Oct 2014, via Haider); critics Haider, Sandifer, Brassier, Williams; worst-case reading tested. Figures: flow; compare
